mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, name, price, original_price, stock, status, view_count, condition_level, location, contact_method, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag, version, MATCH(name) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance FROM product WHERE MATCH(name) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AND status = #{status} ORDER BY relevance DESC, create_time DESC
